readout_other: modified Eriksen flanker task with emotional face distractors; EEG ERPs; heart rate variability; PANAS
direction_notes: tFUS to dACC reduced reaction-time slowing due to emotional distractors and increased parasympathetic HRV markers relative to sham, and altered ERP and oscillatory responses; the authors describe physiologic responses as inhibited.

exposures.label: tFUS to dACC, 0.5 MHz, 500 ms per trial delivered online

device.manufacturer: Blatek, Inc., State College, PA, USA

timing.protocol_description: Each tFUS pulse had a carrier frequency of 0.5 MHz, PRF 1000 Hz, 24% duty cycle and duration of 500 ms, delivered online on each main-task trial (starting with a sham sound 28 ms before distractor onset) under MR-neuronavigation. The paper uses "pulse" for the 500 ms train; individual pulse duration is not stated.
